{{Quote|Welcome, Lieutenant Ndigo. I've heard of your bravery on Rorsack. Nevertheless, it is an honor to meet you.|[[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="CE3.1">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 1|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Lar Ndigo''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]].

==Biography==
In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Lar Ndigo met [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after he distinguished himself in a [[Battle of Rirsack|battle]] on [[Rirsack]]. During the [[Battle of Nam Chorios]], Organa sent Ndigo to assist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] on [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]].<ref name="CE3.1" />

However, Ndigo, now a [[Captain/Legends|captain]], only met General Solo in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Pallaxides]]. Solo assigned him a [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Liberty'' type Star Cruiser]] to investigate the [[Ambush at RZ7-6113-23|disappearance]] of the cruiser [[Endor (Dauntless-class)|''Endor'']] soon before.<ref name="CE3.4">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 4|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 4]]</ref>

[[File:Battle_of_RZ7-6113-23.jpg|thumb|left|220px|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Lar Ndigo on the bridge of his cruiser during the [[Battle of RZ7-6113-23]].]]

When arriving near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[RZ7-6113-23]], Captain Ndigo's ship was [[Battle of RZ7-6113-23|engaged]] by a surface-to-space cannon. Fearing a trap, he ordered the activation of the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] just before the impact. While the surface cannon was reloading, his damaged ship was immediately attacked by old [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighters]] but they were easily repelled by the more modern [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]]. Understanding that his ship was too damaged to resist another hit, even with the shields at maximum power, Ndigo decided to disable the shields and concentrate all power to the [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] so as to attack the planet. The cruiser was able to destroy the surface cannon before it could shoot the ship once again.<ref name="CE3.4" />
